subject: EdgeCare variable accelerator credit — VP/CFO sign-off requested
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@edgecare.ai>, EdgeCare Procurement <procure@edgecare.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeCare pilot pricing request — proposed variable accelerator credit

Marta / team,

Great conversation yesterday — thanks for the level-setting. EdgeCare's clinical summarization pilot looks compelling and they'd like a commercial path to scale quickly if early metrics hold. They asked us for a short-term package to lower their initial per-token economics while they ramp inference footprint.

Summary of what we discussed (ask to Redwood leadership):
- 3-month accelerator discount: 30% off standard per-token rates for the first 3 months of production traffic
- Onboarding credit: $75,000 one-time to cover initial training/ingestion cost and engineer seat for launch week
- Success rebate: additional up-to-$50k rebate paid upon hitting 10M generated tokens/month by month 4

Why this structure: it reduces their friction to commit a pilot while giving us clear triggers to claw back via the success rebate and to move them onto regular pricing after month 3. We believe this materially increases the probability of a paid conversion and higher long-term ARR.

Can you review internally and let me know if VP/CFO signoff is required for the proposed structure? If yes — I can draft an exec memo with ARR impact and margin scenarios. Deal reference: DEAL-9872.

Attachments: pricing impact model (edgecare_pricing_impact_model.xlsx) — quick sensitivity table included.

Best,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeCare pilot pricing request — proposed variable accelerator credit

Rohan —

Thanks for the note and model. High level thoughts:

- The one-time onboarding credit plus a temporary rate cut is reasonable for a high-probability pilot, but the numbers need a tighter guardrail. A $75k credit + 30% off could push the payback beyond safe thresholds if conversion stalls.
- We should prefer a commit/step-down structure where the initial deep discount is tied to a low MRR commitment (e.g., 6 months at 35% of projected run-rate) and the success rebate is contingent on observable production metrics and SOC2 + security completion.
- Please quantify the downside (best/likely/worst) in ARR leakage terms and show a version where the onboarding credit is staged (25k upfront, remainder on milestone).

If you can provide the staged credit version and a sensitivity for churn/conversion assumptions, I'll prepare an executive memo for VP/CFO review. Also loop in Aditya — he'll need the tail-risk numbers.

On quoting your original message: 
> 3-month accelerator discount: 30% off standard per-token rates for the first 3 months

We should avoid blanket deep discounts for months without a firm commitment schedule.

Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

---
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta@edgecare.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeCare pilot pricing request — proposed variable accelerator credit

Team —

Thanks, Marissa. Attached is an updated model and a recommended structure that balances defensibility and commercial velocity (edgecare_pricing_impact_model.xlsx attached; term sheet draft separate). Key points: 

Recommended package (compromise):
- Intro discount: 20% off per-token for first 3 months (rather than the 30% requested)
- Onboarding credit: $50k upfront, $25k milestone after production traffic sustained for 30 days
- Success rebate: up to $50k paid if >=10M generated tokens/month sustained in month 4+
- Minimum pilot commitment: 3 months with an opt-in to extend to 6 months at the same blended rate if metrics are met
- Condition: SOC2 in progress (proof of report within 60 days) and use of our Dedicated routing for PHI-sensitive routes (to satisfy compliance ask)

Impact (high-level):
- Worst-case revenue leakage (no conversion): ~$45k net (after staged credit)
- Expected-case: conversion to paid in month 4 with annualized ARR influence of $240k
- Upside: higher ARR if they accelerate to multi-region in 12 months

Why we need VP/CFO signoff: the staged credit + rebate combination is a one-off concession outside standard guardrails and will require a documented exec approval to move legal and procurement quickly. Deal ID: DEAL-9872.

Marta — FYI on the compromise; this is the package we'd like to present subject to sign-off. If the EdgeCare team can accept the staged approach we can get legal rolling once internal approval is secured.

Attachments: edgecare_pricing_impact_model.xlsx; edgecare_term_sheet_draft.pdf

Thanks,
Rohan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeCare pilot pricing request — proposed variable accelerator credit

Rohan / Marissa / Priyom —

Reviewed the updated model and the recommended compromise. Conditioned sign-off provided (VP/CFO) with the following explicit constraints: 

1) Staged onboarding credit only: $50k upfront, $25k on 30-day production milestone. No other upfront concessions.
2) Intro discount capped at 20% and limited to the SKU(s) they will actually use; applies only to infra inference token pricing, not add-on services.
3) Success rebate payable only after finance verifies token volumes from our telemetry and after the security milestone (SOC2 evidence) is uploaded to our shared drive.
4) Approval limited to 6-month maximum term for the pilot pricing; any extension must re-enter the exception process.

Rohan — you have permission to present the revised term sheet to EdgeCare and to instruct Legal to prepare an expedited order form reflecting these conditions. Please copy Finance on the signed order form and reference DEAL-9872.

Aditya Rao
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
